U.note: Trace-first entry (burn line vs lightning scar, unknown winter range, disputed flame) is inventive, compact and honest about sources.

V.note: Fjord wyrm with seasonal table, hoard-as-midden, reused roosts and wingless lindworm variants is richly consistent, though a little long.

W.note: Competent but stock dragon (hoarding, horns, fire gland, thief remembered) with vague lore and some generic padding.

X.note: Taxonomic-record form with etymology, type skin and disputed shepherd sighting is clever, but opens with a chatty preamble and is dense.

Y.note: Ember seam is a nice mark and the at-a-glance table and sighting log are usable, but the rest is familiar fantasy-dragon fare.

Z.note: Grounded wingless fell dragon with band-count identification and synonyms is tidy and usable, if modest in invention.
